mentions.name: listening4
mentions.description: A social listening tool that finds relevant posts via semantic matching rather than keyword matching, supports AI filtering of results, and adds a localized listening feature that matches posts only in specific languages.
mentions.problem: Current social listening tools rely on keyword matching rather than semantic matching.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm developing another social listening tool: listening4 and that's how I stumbled upon your post, haha. Unlike current tools, it's based on semantic matching rather than keywords, and it also supports AI filtering.
